description: This Java class 'Log' acts as a helper/wrapper around Android's native logging utilities, allowing for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), managing LogNode chains, and standardizing logging calls within an Android project.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging at different levels, managing LogNode chains, and abstracting Android's native Log class.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode for logging output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log messages to the current LogNode, with overloads for including or omitting a Throwable.
